name: social-media-ad-research
description: Research competitors' ads and social content from your AI agent: search the Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn and Google ad libraries, YouTube videos, channels and transcripts, Instagram's trending Reels, Threads posts and Reddit discussions. Find the longest-running ads, compare creatives and offers, mine pain points and customer language from comments, and export CSV. Pay per result on your Apify account.

interface.longDescription: Research competitors' ads and social content from your AI agent: search the Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn and Google ad libraries, YouTube videos, channels and transcripts, Instagram's trending Reels, Threads posts and Reddit discussions. Find the longest-running ads, compare creatives and offers, mine pain points and customer language from comments, and export CSV. Pay per result on your Apify account. Includes 4 skills (audience-insights, competitor-ad-research, social-content-research, social-research-cost-estimate) and Apify's hosted MCP server limited to Imzlab's Actors. After installing, run `codex mcp login social-research` to sign in to Apify in the browser.
